relationships.notes: Mira stands near the threshold with Halen. Halen trusts Mira but doesn't understand her ambivalence. They see it as a weight she carries, not a choice she makes.
Sael understands the effort of welcoming. Halen feels seen by the warden in a way no one else sees them.
Halen has never met The Rendered directly. They feel a vague dread toward the Ashen Covenant — not hatred, but the fear of someone who knows the cold exists without having felt it.
